summary: Verified both prior phases against the code and produced an ordered plan: narrow classifyQuery to a start-anchored !-prefix regex in Core, update two response strings + two unit tests + three docs, and regenerate the bundled-docs artifact. No human decision needed.

details.chosen_approach: Narrow classifyQuery in place (single start-anchored regex + progress #N check); rejected a centralized command-vocabulary table as unrequested complexity.
details.gap_found: query-handler.ts:252 (formatUnrecognizedResponse) has a second user-facing 'send "status"' pointer the prior inventories missed; plan moves it to '!status'.
resolved_parser_calls: !progress without #N -> unknown (preserves progress<->#N invariant; avoids 'Issue #undefined not found')
'! status' (gap after prefix) -> not a command (Req #1 'immediately followed')
details.non_obvious_gate: Editing the two docs/plugins/ files requires `pnpm run docs:bundle`; otherwise plugin-docs.test.ts (byte-for-byte) and CI (git diff --exit-code) go red.
